fusions.name: Mauling Swat
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Overturned Hive
fusions.desc: A swarm that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. [Poisoned] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Honey Gorge
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Stingproof Hide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 15%.
